name: Zadok
role: Priest under David, first high priest of Solomon's temple
whenBasis: In David's reign, ≈1010–970 BC, counted back from Solomon as Thiele does.
summary: Son of Ahitub, of Eleazar's line, priest with Abiathar under David. In Absalom's revolt he carried the ark out of Jerusalem, and David sent him back with it; his son Ahimaaz carried news to David. He stayed loyal when Adonijah claimed the throne, anointed Solomon at Gihon, and replaced Abiathar. Ezekiel's temple is served by the sons of Zadok.
body: David tells him to take the ark back to the city: if he finds favour with the LORD he will see it again. Zadok and Abiathar keep David informed through their sons.
His descendants hold the high priesthood until the exile and after. Ezekiel singles them out as the priests who kept charge of the sanctuary when Israel went astray.

moments.text: Priest with Ahimelech son of Abiathar

later.text: The Sadducees, the priestly party of the New Testament period, take their name from him, as Gary Porton reports the derivation.
